deepcharter.handbook.letter.body.1:
Welcome to Prosperity!

Every great company is built by hands like yours. Here at H. Colom & Co. we ask only for honest work, and we give back everything we can. The ground beneath you is rich, the work is plentiful, and every ore you bring up makes Prosperity a little brighter.
deepcharter.handbook.letter.body.2:
I look forward to meeting you personally one day.
Warmly,

CY 19. We broke through below the Workings today. Caves full of light, Tomas, light growing out of the walls. Best day of my life.

CY 19, later. Tomas went back down alone. When he came up he'd left his lamp behind. He says he doesn't need it. He says it's brighter without.

CY 20. He doesn't sleep. He walks the rail line at night with no lamp, all the way to the end and back.

CY 20. The Badger boys quit today and went down our shaft. Pell says it's quieter down there than anywhere up here.

CY 20. He didn't come back from the rail line. I'm leaving the Prospector at the end of it with the lights on, so he can find her. I'm taking our old shaft down on foot to find him.

deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Welcome to Prosperity

Prosperity has been a little quiet lately, so you'll start the way our founders did: with what they left behind. Pry open the Company salvage crates scattered round town for wood, cloth and scrap, and cut the pale stalks that grow in the craters where a tree would. Make yourself some tools, melt the scrap down for iron, and keep everything you craft. Nothing builds character like a fresh start!
Every terminal in town went dark tonight except the contract terminal. Think about that. —R.

deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Bringing Prosperity Back Online

Prosperity's terminals were taken offline after the Night Shift, and we need you to bring them back, one at a time. Each terminal shows the parts it needs. Start with the fuel pump, then the ore processor, then the upgrade terminal. When any charter repairs a terminal, it works for everyone. That's the Prosperity spirit!
Prosperity's previous workforce has been relocated. We are confident you will make the colony your own.
They change this page. They always change this page. —R.
Put your ear to the processor. Refineries don't sound like that. —R.
Meet the Mole

In the hangar you'll find the Mole, the first pod Prosperity ever put to work. She needs a little love before she flies again. Each repair the hangar lists brings her closer. (If another charter has already repaired her, a refurbished Mole is available at the hangar for a modest fee.)
MOLE-0001. She's carried more of us than the bunkhouse has. Be good to her. —R.
Fuel Is Life

Fuel is the lifeblood of every Colom pod! Your Mole burns fuel whenever she is powered on, faster while moving and fastest while drilling. Drive on her treads, fly with her rotor, and drill down or sideways, but never up. Watch the F bar on the ribbon along the top of your view (it turns red when she runs low), listen for the low-fuel tone, and always plan your trip home. A pod that runs dry is Stranded: she powers down and goes dark until someone rescues her or she's refuelled from a reserve tank. Don't fret: after one minute of waiting, a Company winch crew hauls her home for a recovery fee of $30 for each layer you are down, taken from your charter's account, or from her hull if the account is bare. Any ore aboard stays where she stopped, so turn for home at the low-fuel tone.

Coal and charcoal soot her engine, and once she clogs she won't launch from the colony. Pay the repair station to service her, or, if the account is bare, scrape the flue there for free and wait a minute by her side. She'll leave slow, but she'll leave.
Don't let her go dark in the Workings. —R.
deepcharter.handbook.directive.fuel_is_l: Refuel the Mole at the colony pump.
deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Every Sale Counts

Ore is heavy, so the Mole is your hauler. Bring ore to the ore processor to sell it; every sale is credited to your charter's account. The first tier of every part is not sold: craft each as a unit from salvage iron, copper and redstone, and use it on your Mole. The lights, hopper, brace, sounder, liner and heat shield also take a little ore: pick WITHDRAW ORE at the ore processor to move it from your Mole's cargo to your pack instead of selling it. Spend your earnings at the upgrade terminal on the tiers after them. All parts are licensed to your charter and carry a Company serial number. Ore gets richer the farther down you go!
Ask where it goes after. The Conduit only runs one way. —R.
deepcharter.handbook.directive.every_sal: Haul ore in the Mole's cargo bay: it's too heavy to carry far.
Sell ore at the ore processor.
Buy a component at the upgrade terminal.
deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Seeing Below

Your scanner shows a slice of the ground around your pod, so you can find ore before you dig for it. Better scanners see farther and show more. Hazards that can't be seen with the eye will show on higher-tier scanners.
If a shape on the scanner moves, it isn't ore. —R.
Staying Safe on the Claim

The Claim is the friendliest ground we have, but it isn't harmless. Watch for undiggable rock, lava you can see, gas pockets you can't, and hard landings. Your hull takes the damage, so repair it at the colony. Accidents happen! The Continuity Plan returns you to work at no cost to you.

Gas gives itself away to those who listen. A seep sounder, sold at the upgrade terminal, makes your pod hiss when a pocket lies below the drill, quicker the nearer it comes, and your display counts the slabs down. Step aside, or fit the better sounder and let the drill bleed the pocket off first.

Near the floor of every layer something gets on the line. First the scanner fills with noise. Then your gauges flicker, jump to numbers that are not true and go dark, the lower you go, and in the last slabs the whole display is gone. The hull lamp and the burning lamp never lie, and the hull alarm keeps sounding, so watch them and fly by feel. A console pushes the trouble back toward the floor: craft the first, buy the better ones at the upgrade terminal. The best one shuts it out.
Not listed: what's in the Workings. —R.
deepcharter.handbook.directive.staying_s: Repair your hull at the colony.
deepcharter.handbook.chapter.deepcharter: Your First Breach

At the floor of the Claim you'll meet a breach: a hard crust between layers. Any drill can get through, slowly, and it's hard on the hull and the heat. Top up your fuel and repair your hull first. On the other side are the Old Workings, Prosperity's original mine levels and a proud part of our heritage.
Every breach is a door. We didn't put the doors there. —R.
Recovering Company Property

Somewhere in the Old Workings lies the Prospector, a two-seat pod that went missing some years ago. Find her, tow her home and restore her, and she's yours to fly. She has a navigator's seat, so bring a friend! Then take her down to the floor of the Workings. You've earned it.
If you hear the song and there's no radio, leave. —R.
Ines's pod. Read her log, then decide if you still want the job. —R.

deepcharter.spec.item.silverium_ore: Silverium, as found. Mine it, sell it, smile.
deepcharter.spec.item.slag_brick: A slag brick. Lines a bore and soaks up lava. Do not eat.
deepcharter.spec.item.smelter_coil: Spare coil for the ore processor's smelter. Gets warm.
deepcharter.spec.item.socket_array: A socket array for terminals. Every socket has a purpose.
deepcharter.spec.item.sounder_unit: Crafted unit. Use it on your pod to fit a tier 1 seep sounder.
deepcharter.spec.item.spoil_hopper_unit: Crafted unit. Use it on your pod to fit a spoil hopper.
deepcharter.spec.item.stalk_meal: Stalk mash. Filling, and locally sourced.
deepcharter.spec.item.stalk_planks: Planks of fungal stalk. Light, damp and Company approved.
deepcharter.spec.item.steel_beam: A steel beam for Company frames. Load rated.
deepcharter.spec.item.steel_ladder: A steel ladder. Up is always an option.
deepcharter.spec.item.tether: Clips you to a pod's winch. Yours to keep.
deepcharter.spec.item.thrown_charge: A charge, thrown by hand. The fuse is short; so is the advice.
deepcharter.spec.item.thrown_decoy: A decoy, thrown by hand. Rings out to draw attention away from you.
deepcharter.spec.item.thrown_flare: A flare, thrown by hand. Lights the dark and keeps the Retained off.
deepcharter.spec.item.tread_assembly: A spare tread assembly for the Mole.
deepcharter.spec.item.upgrade_board: Spare board for the upgrade terminal. Fits where it fits.
deepcharter.spec.item.upgrade_terminal: Buy pod parts here. Prices are posted, and final.
deepcharter.spec.item.wall_lamp: A wall lamp for Company corridors. Warm and glowing.
deepcharter.spec.item.wax_cylinder: One recording on wax. Fragile, so handle it like a sealed contract.
deepcharter.spec.item.welding_arm: A welding arm for repairs. Steady hands not required.
deepcharter.spec.item.window_glass: Window glass for Company buildings. Please do not lean.
deepcharter.spec.stock: Standard stock. Company-approved, if not Company-made.
